subject: MAP kickoff: roles, timeline options, dependencies
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@clearsight.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: roles, timeline options, dependencies (draft attached)

Hi Ellen — great discovery earlier. Thanks for the time. I captured the key milestones and owners in the attached Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and outlined three timeline options below so we can pick a target close window. Please review, confirm your internal stakeholders, and tell us which timeline you prefer (Conservative / Baseline / Accelerated).

Quick recap from the call:
- Primary use case: inference at scale for clinical notes ingestion (low-latency scoring, embedding search)
- Key success criteria: sub-200ms P95 inference for 512 tokens, SOC2 evidence for data handling, predictable monthly spend
- Decision makers: Ellen Park (Product), Samir Gupta (Security), Procurement (billing/contract)

Attached milestones (high level):
1) Contract & Procurement (Procurement) — sign DocuSign (target close)
2) Technical Kickoff (Redwood engineer + Clearsight infra) — SSO & test data access
3) Pilot / Validation (integration + perf tests) — success criteria validated
4) Rollout & Ops (runbook, alerting, cost guardrails) — handoff to platform team

Timeline options (pick one):
- Conservative: 12–14 weeks — allows for full security QA and procurement cycles
- Baseline: 6–8 weeks — target we usually recommend for similar workloads (recommended)
- Accelerated: 3–4 weeks — requires procurement pre-approval and priority onboarding slots

Actions I need from you:
- Confirm stakeholders (security reviewer, procurement contact)
- Pick timeline option or share constraints that would push to Conservative
- If Baseline/Accelerated, confirm availability for a technical kickoff next week

Attachments: Clearsight-MAP-v0.1.xlsx (MAP draft), redwood-product-fit-deck.pdf (short reference)

Thanks — I’ll update and re-share a v0.2 once we’ve locked stakeholders.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0107
From: Ellen Park <ellen@clearsight.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearsight.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: roles, timeline options, dependencies (draft attached)

Marcus — thanks for the clear recap and for getting the draft to us. Quick answers:
- Confirm stakeholders: please add Samir Gupta (samir.g@clearsight.com) as security reviewer. I’ve cc’d procurement.
- Timeline: Baseline looks reasonable to me, but two asks before we lock it:
  * Security will need the SOC2 documentation and a short answers doc for our privacy team (can you share the SOC2 availability window?)
  * We prefer weekly 30-min checkpoints during the pilot window (Wednesdays)

On the kickoff, can we tentatively schedule something for next Tues/Thurs afternoons (PDT)? I’ll confirm Samir’s availability.

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Product, Clearsight Health
ellen@clearsight.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@clearsight.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@clearsight.com>, procurement@clearsight.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: roles, timeline options, dependencies (baseline selected)

Thanks Ellen — baseline it is. I added Samir to the thread and updated the MAP (attached v0.2) to include a security review milestone and a weekly checkpoint cadence during the pilot. High-level updates in v0.2:
- Added Security Review (owner: Samir Gupta, target: 2 weeks before pilot)
- Added weekly pilot checkpoints (owner: Ellen/Redwood)
- Proposed target close date: 2027-05-14 (Baseline 6–8 week path)

Monica — can you own coordinating the Technical Kickoff with Clearsight (schedule, agenda, and internal resource assignment)? I’ve cc’d Aditya to be the primary Redwood engineering for the kickoff and pilot.

Next steps (for the thread):
- Ellen/procurement: confirm DocuSign contact and any mandatory PO process (we’ll generate the initial SOW + MSAs)
- Samir: if you can send a short list of SOC2 artifact requests we’ll get those to you within 48 hours
- Monica/Aditya: propose two kickoff slots next week (Tues/Thurs afternoons PDT)

Attachments: Clearsight-MAP-v0.2.xlsx

I’ll also open the HubSpot deal and drop the DocuSign link once procurement confirms the contact.

Best,
Marcus
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen@clearsight.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@clearsight.com>, procurement@clearsight.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: roles, timeline options, dependencies (coordination)

Internal note + scheduling update for the thread (looping external attendees so everyone has visibility).

Marcus / Aditya — I’ll take point on scheduling and owning the Technical Kickoff agenda. Early checklist for Redwood prep:
- Confirm Aditya availability for Tuesday 3pm PDT or Thursday 2:30pm PDT — I’ll send a calendar invite once Ellen confirms which slot works best for Clearsight
- Dependencies we need from Clearsight before kickoff:
  * Test Okta SSO account (staging) + short test dataset (anonymized samples)
  * Network allowlist IPs if test infra is behind a firewall
  * List of performance targets and top-5 priority endpoints
- Contracts/procurement: Marcus — once procurement confirms the contact, please generate the initial SOW and I’ll review for technical dependencies. I’ll also prepare a short onboarding checklist for the pilot runbook.

Samir / Ellen — linking SOC2 doc request: we’ll upload standard Redwood SOC2 summary and an answers doc to the shared folder; Samir, please confirm any additional artifacts you need and we’ll prioritize.

HubSpot/Docs: I’ll add DEAL-8791 notes and include the MAP v0.2 link (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8791) in the invite. Expect a DocuSign draft after procurement confirms contact.

Monica Patel
